items.title: 백악관 “이란에 휴전 연장 요청 안해…합의 전망 긍정적” - 한겨레

summaries.en: The White House expressed optimism about reaching an agreement with Iran through productive negotiations, denying reports of a ceasefire extension request and emphasizing Trump's demand for nuclear disarmament.
